title: Serenity on the Wind
subtitle: If only this war had never begun ...

items.text: Serenity on the Wind

items.speaker: War Horse
items.text: Neigh.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Here, come on out. That's a good boy.
The horse seems to naturally gravitate to the knight, drooping its head to brush up against her.

items.speaker: War Horse
items.text: Neigh ...

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Haha.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Oh my, Marie, look at his beautiful coat! Not even the colonels have such handsome companions.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: He seems to have taken a liking to you. Can you ride?

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: What sort of question is that, Marianne? You're talking to a knight.
Even without a saddle, she mounts the horse with ease.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Come on, take my hand. I'll give you a ride.
After a moment's hesitation, Sentinel takes the offered hand and finds herself on the horse's back as well.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: This field is perfect for a gallop, but I'm worried you might fall.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Let me off, then. Enjoy it yourself.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: What fun would that be? Come on, just hold on tight.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Giddy up!

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Hey!

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Hahahaha!

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: I can't believe you don't know how to ride a horse. But I can teach you. Just think of them as oversized hunting dogs.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: I'll come find you after you move. How does that sound? Where will you be if you're not staying with your family?

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Perhaps Paris? My mind is yet made. But, wherever I am, I should like to open a clothing store.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Then you'd better choose a store name I'll recognize right away. No, you'll become so famous that it'll take no work to find you.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Could you make a parade dress for me?

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: I have never before made such a dress, but, I shall learn for you.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Wow, a parade dress tailor-made for me by a famous French fashion designer. It's like a dream come true.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Heh ...
This might be the first moment of true peace they've felt since the war began.
The horse grows tired. They dismount to let it roam and feed on the tall meadow grass.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: What of you? How may I come into your contact? The Lord only knows where the Foundation will send you once this is ended.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: You may be right. The fight against Manus Vindictae isn't over. But don't worry. I'll always find a way to get in touch with you.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: I do not wish to judge your decision, but do all you can to stay alive, Marsha. Do not make a martyr of yourself.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Why the sudden sentimentality, Marie?

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: If all this—when all this—comes to an end one day, I hope ... I hope to see you again.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Me too.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: I will pray for you, though I am uncertain if my voice will be heard.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: I am nothing like Agnès. She is an angel descended from heaven. And I am ...
The Gargoyle keeps her eyes hidden in the shadow.

items.speaker: Sentinel
items.text: Never mind.
*beep-beep*

items.speaker: War Horse
items.text: Neigh!

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Hmm?
The communicator's noise startles the nibbling horse. It lifts its head and bolts into the distance.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Ah, there he goes.
She picks up the device. Again, it's an anonymous caller.
Marsha, we need you on the front immediately. I've already sent you the coordinates.
Bring the Gargoyle if she's willing.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Who are you?
We'll meet soon enough.
